acceptance_criteria.text: Reject oversized JSON frames above 256 KiB and data arrays above 100 messages before expensive normalization.
Bound subscription controls to at most 32 channel lists, 100 symbols per list, and 32 characters per channel or symbol.
Accept only safe integer stream error codes in the documented HTTP error range 400-599, preserve codes, and map unknown valid codes to a generic application-owned name.
Never return provider-controlled error text; known codes map to stable application-owned names and credential-shaped text cannot escape through decoded controls.
Focused deterministic tests cover limits, error-code validation, message suppression, existing frame parsing, and credential-free operation.
